body: Possibly related to #31333? @ddramone can you try again with the latest Angular/CLI?
I've tried the latest cli (8.1.0), didn't work. (updated package versions in the repo as well)

I got the same problem. 
It appears only if tests are running with code coverage: `ng test --code-coverage`
The usual `ng test` or any type of build (JIT or AOT) gives no errors.

For now the problem can be solved by injecting services on child level and passing them to parent component.
tested on angular 8.2.11 with cli 8.3.12 and it is still not fixed, now I have to add tons of workarounds :(

Same here. It seems to be somewhat random when it happens.

I have 2 classes using the same base class. The test always fails for one derived class and works for the other.

I can also confirm that it only fails if "--code-coverage" is used.
